/privacy.title: Privacy Policy — Proiectum
/privacy.description: How Proiectum collects, uses and protects your information.
p: Proiectum is an independent design studio based in Jakarta, Indonesia. This policy explains what we collect when you visit proiectum.studio or get in touch, and what we do with it.

When you send an inquiry we receive your name, email, company and the details you choose to share. When you browse the site we collect anonymous usage data such as pages viewed and approximate location.
We use inquiry details only to reply to you and to prepare a proposal. Usage data helps us understand which work people find useful. We never sell personal data.
We use privacy-friendly analytics that do not set tracking cookies or build profiles across websites. Embedded videos may set their own cookies when you play them.
Inquiries are stored in our email and project tools, hosted in the EU. We only share data with the services that make this possible, under data processing agreements.
You can ask us to access, correct or delete the information we hold about you at any time, and we will respond within 30 days.
Questions about privacy? Write to proiectumsstudio@gmail.com.

/services.title: Services — Proiectum
/services.description: Brand identity, digital and motion — three disciplines, one studio.
p: We work across brand, digital and motion — often all three at once, so the identity, the interface and the film speak with one voice.
Naming, identity systems and guidelines built to outlast a trend.
Websites and product interfaces that are fast, plain and easy to keep up to date.
Titles, brand films and interaction that give a system its rhythm.
From first call to launch, in four honest steps.
Workshops, interviews and a close look at the market, ending in a one-page brief everyone signs.
Strategy, naming and the core idea — tested in rough before anything gets polished.
Identity, interface and motion built side by side, reviewed with you every Friday.
Build, guidelines and launch support — then we stay on to measure and refine.
A defined scope with a clear start and finish — an identity, a website or a film.
A standing team for launches, campaigns and everything in between.
Two focused weeks to unblock a name, a pitch or a prototype.
Anything else? Write to proiectumsstudio@gmail.com — a real person replies.
How early should we reach out?
Ideally six to eight weeks before you want to start — we take on a handful of projects at a time.

Can you work with our in-house team?
Often. We share files, sit in your channels and hand over systems your team can run without us.
Jakarta, working with clients across Europe, the Gulf and North America.
Most identity and website projects land between $25k and $100k. Sprints start at $8k.
Do you stay on after launch?
If you want us to. Many clients keep a light retainer for new pages, campaigns and the odd late-night fix.

/about.title: About — Proiectum
/about.description: An independent design studio working across identity, motion and interface.
h1: Most brands don’t need more noise. They need one clear idea, carried all the way through.
h2: We are a small studio. We take on a handful of projects a year and finish every one of them properly.
We hire rarely, and on purpose. If that sounds like you, say hello.
h3: Five years, one room, and a habit of saying no to the wrong work.
Small enough to know every project by heart.
p: Proiectum was founded in 2021 and works across identity, motion and interface. We are deliberately small — the people you meet are the people who do the work.
We prefer long engagements to quick ones, and we would rather ship one considered thing than five hurried ones.
Every project is led by the people who pitched it. No hand-offs, no junior B-team.
We stay after launch — refining, measuring and growing the work with the teams who own it.
Details are the work. We keep going until the last page reads as well as the first.
Two designers, one borrowed desk and a first identity for a Jakarta café that is still open.
Brand films and title sequences became part of every identity, not an afterthought.
Aeon Capital and Marée took the studio to Europe and the Gulf — still with a team of four.
Bigger clients, the same promise: the people who pitch the work are the people who make it.
